parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-24 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1101.7 | 4.18 | 4.18
2 | 1144.4 | 12.44 | 16.62
3 | 549.8 | 0.62 | 17.24
4 | 173.3 | 7.65 | 24.89
5 | 2079.8 | 25.05 | 49.94
6 | 1111.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KQHK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-24
Curve type: KQHK
Aquifer depth: 17.24 – 24.89 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity weathered/fractured zone between 17.24 m and 24.89 m, terminating drilling at approximately 28–30 m upon sufficient penetration into the underlying competent bedrock. Install well screens across the 17.24–24.89 m interval to maximize groundwater yield.
